item.title: Ohio motorists use their phones while driving less than national average, study finds
item.description: A study has found that Ohio drivers use their phones less than the national average, with state leaders crediting a state law passed in 2023 that bans drivers from holding a cellphone in most instances.

item.title: Cynthia Erivo, Ariana Grande win first Grammy Award given out Sunday
item.description: The 68th annual Grammy Awards are taking place Sunday at the Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles, and spirits were high from the jump.

item.title: 'Difficult decision': Another local brewery shuttering its doors
item.description: A local brewery announced it is closing its doors after nearly a decade in business.

item.title: Warming centers in Cleveland, Akron open through the weekend
item.description: With temperatures well below freezing and sub-zero wind chills in the forecast for several more days, the cities of Akron and Cleveland announced they'd be extending their warming centers through the weekend.

item.title: Fraternity members arrested after alleged hazing death in Arizona
item.description: Three students at Northern Arizona University and members of the Delta Tau Delta fraternity are facing hazing charges after a pledge died following a rush event for the fraternity.

item.title: Rosé, Bruno Mars, Sabrina Carpenter open 2026 Grammy Awards with electric performances
item.description: The hits arrived fast and furious. Rosé and Bruno Mars opened the 68th annual Grammy Awards Sunday with an electric rendition of their multicultural pop smash, “APT."; the Blackpink singer channeled a pop-punk Gwen Stefani in her tie and platinum blond hair.

item.title: Cleveland Cavaliers Donovan Mitchell selected as All-Star reserve
item.description: Cleveland Cavaliers guard Donovan Mitchell was officially selected as a reserve for the 2026 NBA All-Star Game in Los Angeles.

item.title: FORECAST: Bitterly cold night ahead
item.description: Sunday will be mostly cloudy and cold, with highs in the mid to upper teens. Once again, wind chills will be much colder than the actual air temperature.

item.title: OSHP: Small plane crashes in Brimfield Township
item.description: A small plane has crashed in Portage County on Sunday afternoon.

item.title: Volunteers clear snow to keep students safe at Canton bus stops
item.description: After a week of heavy snowfall that forced closures at schools across Northeast Ohio, volunteers in Canton helped make sure students have a safe path back to the classroom on Sunday.
